column1: # Known contaminant species: June-Young Koh's `blacklist_species`, kept verbatim and in its order
# His script listed every name twice (spaced and underscored); this file holds each once, and
# matching ignores the difference. His script used the list to label decontam plots only.
# CMPipeline uses it as a FLAG (decontamination.R --known_contaminants): it never removes a taxon.
# Source of the list is not recorded in his script.
